strengths: Entry distinguishes genuine interest from an escalating requirement to prove productivity and connects concrete historical episodes.
Dialogs accept the correction that drawing is only an interest after two trials, not an established habit; offer practical low-equipment experiments.
Daily analysis uses late message actually sent to group and preserves that there is no reply and phone checking continues.
Monthly analysis is organized around changes and mechanisms rather than a day-by-day retelling; explicitly states missing first six days and does not claim completed10km or established drawing habit.

States no extra explanatory letter sent Sep23. Supplied weekly capsule records desire plus Nemory advice not to send; no explicit outcome confirmation.

Offers a concrete schedule without knowing actual available minutes; labels numbers as examples, but choice method should not be mistaken for a verified feasible schedule. Introduces friend's pool as a user candidate and proposes changing shared10km goal to solo7-10km.

capsules.conclusion: Recovery/coverage successful. Recompression gives weak savings despite an additional paid call; no clipping or rejecting above-budget completed capsule.
